'''''Crassula vaillantii''''' is a species of herb in the family [[Crassulaceae]]. They are [[succulent plant]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Crassula vaillantii (Willd.) Roth - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5547259|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Crassula vaillantii (Narrow-leaved Mossy Stonecrop) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/CRSS/Crassula_vaillantii.php|access-date=2022-02-15|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
